title: Self Power and Other Power
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk highlights the importance of recognizing the role of mystery and otherness in Zen practice, particularly when it comes to understanding Buddhist texts. Rather than relying solely on individual effort or self-power, Zen encourages us to acknowledge the larger forces at work, such as compassion and the interconnectedness of all phenomena. By embracing this perspective, we can deepen our understanding of the text and cultivate a more authentic and compassionate practice.
